# Project Overview

This is reusable React component for displaying live real-time time series chart.

## Folder Structure

- `/src`: Contains the source code for the demo purposes
- `lib`: Contains the source code for the chart itself

## Libraries and Frameworks

- React and Tailwind CSS for the frontend.

## Coding Standards

- Use semicolons at the end of each statement.
- Do not use code comments
- Do not generate examples
- Do not generate markdown documentation unless specifically requested
